title: Six-channel divided and filtered analog input board

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Use a rectangular 80 mm × 50 mm board outline (dimension tolerance 0.1 mm) with two copper layers.

Use six two-pin input headers J1 through J6, each with pin 1 assigned IN1 through IN6 respectively and pin 2 GND. Use an eight-pin output header J7 with pins 1 through 8 assigned OUT1, OUT2, OUT3, OUT4, OUT5, OUT6, GND, GND. Inputs are nominally in the 0 V to 5 V range; outputs are intended for high-impedance measurement.

For each channel i from 1 through 6, connect a 10 kohm resistor from INi to a private divider node DIVi and a 20 kohm resistor from DIVi to GND. Connect a 1 kohm resistor from DIVi to OUTi and a 100 nF capacitor from OUTi to GND. Give all 24 passive components unique references. Do not join divider nodes or output nodes across channels.
Provide one exposed test pad at least 1 mm in diameter on each OUTi, plus one on GND, and label them. Place each output capacitor within 10 mm of J7 centre.
Arrange J1 through J6 along the top edge with centres within 6 mm of it and at least 11 mm centre spacing. Place J7 within 6 mm of the bottom edge, measured from its centre.
Add four nonplated 3.2 mm mounting holes centred 4 mm from each adjacent board edge. Keep copper and component bodies at least 1 mm from each hole edge.
Editable schematic and fully placed and routed PCB are supplied with readable entry files and a README documenting component choices and unresolved requirements.
Header pitch, passive packages, component pin mapping, silkscreen, board containment, copper clearance, trace widths, and complete routing satisfy the common prompt requirements.
